text: 你为啥要反驳这种脑子长在勾八上的这种人？
en: Why on earth would you argue back with people whose brains are stuck up their arses?

text: 什么卖淫多了强奸就少了，这些都是扯淡。
en: All that about more prostitution meaning fewer rapes — it's sheer nonsense.

text: 解决自己需求最及时有效快速的方法都是手动。
en: The most immediate, effective and quick way to meet your own needs is by hand.

text: 说这种话的人，真的卖淫合法化了（假如），他会问为啥技师不主动来推销自己。
en: If prostitution really were legalised (hypothetically), the sort of person who says this would then ask why the technicians don't come and pitch themselves.

text: 还要我自己去找，一点市场意识都没有。
en: And I'd have to go and look for them myself — they've got no market sense at all.

text: 反正这类人的核心思想就是：我怎么方便怎么来。
en: Anyway, the core thinking of this sort of person is: I'll do whatever's convenient for me.

text: 只要我不方便，那肯定是别人有问题。
en: As long as something inconveniences me, then someone else must be in the wrong.

text: 就像草履虫一样，会进行简单的生命活动。
en: They're just like a paramecium, carrying out simple life activities.

text: 我觉得大部分口嗨合法化的人，并不是真想合法化。
en: I think most of the people who just talk big about legalisation don't actually want it legalised.

text: 更多是对州官放火行为的宣泄。
en: It's more an outpouring of that 'only the magistrate may set fires' sort of mentality.

text: 被灵岛的包养不就是合法的吗？
en: Isn't being kept by Lingdao already legal?

text: 我想不出包养和卖淫有啥区别，灵岛现在起步都包100多个，理论上灵岛每时每刻都在PC，抓进去关15天都可以关到死。
en: I can't see the difference between being kept and prostitution. Lingdao now starts you off keeping over a hundred — in theory Lingdao is whoremongering at every single moment, and if you got locked up for fifteen days at a time you could be locked up till you died.

text: 现在小保真就是导管导得记忆力下降了？
en: Has Xiao Baozhen's memory gone downhill from all that piping?

text: 飞机杯在95年之前就是淫秽物品。
en: Before 1995, fleshlights were classified as obscene articles.

text: 能合法化全靠90年代的自由派重拳闹钟的劳保。
en: The only reason they could be legalised at all was the 90s liberals' heavy-fisted, alarm-clock-style labour welfare protections.

text: 真以为自己能玩杯子是天赋人权啊？
en: Do you really think being able to play with a cup is some heaven-bestowed natural right?

text: 还好意思说能买杯子说明没有性专营
en: And you still have the nerve to say that being able to buy a cup shows there's no state monopoly on sex.

text: 他们讨论卖淫合法化的时候我不反驳，等他们讨论吸毒合法化的时候就没人支持我了。
en: When they were debating prostitution legalisation I didn't argue back, so when they debate drug legalisation no one will side with me.

text: 这不是神神最喜欢的滑坡谬误吗
en: Isn't this exactly the slippery-slope fallacy that the shen-shen love most?

text: 他只看到了卖淫合法会导致强奸犯变少？
en: He only sees that legalising prostitution would mean fewer rapists?

text: 他看不到卖淫合法背后的人口贩卖？
en: Can't he see the human trafficking behind legalised prostitution?

text: 看不到逼良为娼？
en: Can't he see the forcing of innocents into prostitution?

text: 他是真以为卖淫合法只要有人愿意做就拿个上岗证就行了？
en: Does he really think that with legalised prostitution, anyone who's willing just needs to pick up a work licence and that's it?

text: 从古至今的青楼，勾栏，教坊司这些风月场所都是在暴力下催生出来的，真以为一团和气来去自由呢？
en: From ancient times to now, the brothels, the goulan, and the Jiaofangsi — these houses of pleasure were all bred under violence. Do you really think it's all harmony and free come-and-go?

text: 我倒是心疼你到底是生活在什么环境才能遇到这种人
en: I'm actually worried about what kind of environment you must be living in to run into this sort of person.

text: 手动分哥.jpg
en: ManualFenGe.jpg

text: 本来不想回他的，这个评论给我一种单纯来抬杠的感觉，但是想想万一他只是纯呢，所以举个例子
en: I didn't originally want to reply to him — this comment gave me the feeling he was just here to argue for the sake of arguing. But then I thought, what if he's just being naive, so I'll give an example.

text: 咱们假设啊，卖银合法化了，然后题主这个亲戚，有个女儿，16岁，长得那叫一个，嘿，又gougou又丢丢，清纯可爱，后来找了个对象，这个对象能文能武，长相十分英俊，这个女儿呢就非他不嫁，原地结婚，这个亲戚不同意呀，他其实是你同父…
en: Let's suppose, right, that prostitution is legalised. Now, this relative of the OP has a daughter, 16 years old, and her looks — wow, she was ever so gougou and diudiu, pure and adorable. Later she found a boyfriend; this boyfriend was accomplished in both letters and martial arts, and extremely handsome. The daughter would marry no one but him, marrying him on the spot. This relative didn't agree, of course — he's actually your same-father…

text: 不是，异父异母的亲哥哥，总之就是不同意，几经波折，女儿最终跟这个人私奔了，亲戚很伤心，彩礼还没给…
en: No — an elder brother with a different father and a different mother. Anyway, he just wouldn't agree. After many twists and turns, the daughter eventually eloped with this man. The relative was heartbroken — the bride price hadn't even been paid…

text: 不是，女儿丢了，很伤心，找呗
en: No — the daughter was lost, and he was heartbroken, so he went looking.

text: 找了两年，没结果呀，老婆也离婚了，心里难受，喝酒，喝完了更难受了，怎么办呢，诶、卖银合法了嘿！
en: He searched for two years with no result. His wife divorced him too. He felt awful, drank, and felt even worse after drinking. So what to do? Oh — prostitution's legal now, innit!

text: 当下就马上行动，找了一家当地比较大的，原来卖金银饰品，后来金店跟卖饰品的都搬走了的大会所，在马路对面啊，呵！
en: Right then he sprang into action and found a fairly large local establishment — one that used to sell gold and silver jewellery, but later the gold shop and the jewellery sellers all moved away — right across the road, hah!

text: 这会所真大，一边走一边脱衣服，进门了根服务员说，来个果盘，过十八的不要！
en: The establishment was huge. He walked in taking his clothes off as he went, and once inside said to the waiter, 'Bring a fruit platter — no one over eighteen!'

text: 服务员说大爷你先把裤子穿上，进屋再说
en: The waiter said, 'Old man, put your trousers back on first; we'll talk once you're in the room.'

text: 进了屋了，往这一躺，等吧，一会儿有人敲门，8号技师为您服务，他一听这声有点熟悉，进来一看，一妙龄少女，长得那叫一个，嘿！
en: He went into the room, lay down there, and waited. After a while someone knocked: 'Technician No. 8 at your service.' The voice sounded a bit familiar. He looked — a young girl, and her looks — wow!

text: 又勾勾又丢丢，心说怎么这么像自己闺女，这8号开始脱衣服，他一看这身上怎么这么多淤青呢，上一位连襟挺暴力呀，等到8号到近前来，他腚眼一看，这tm就是自己闺女，当下两眼含泪说闺女，你怎么到这来干上这个了！
en: So gougou and diudiu — he thought, why does she look so much like his own daughter. Technician No. 8 began to take her clothes off. He noticed — why are there so many bruises on her body? The previous punter was pretty violent. When No. 8 came closer, he took a proper look and — bloody hell, this is his own daughter. Tearfully he said, 'Daughter, how did you end up doing this here!'

text: 他闺女说爸你别闹了，这是正经生意，再说工作时要称职务，叫我8号技师，为啥是8号，我被卖过来那天排老8，专业做小汉堡
en: His daughter said, 'Dad, stop messing about, this is a proper business. Besides, at work you use the job title — call me Technician No. 8. Why No. 8? The day I was sold here I was eighth in line. I specialise in making little hamburgers.'

text: 这亲戚不乐意了呀，闹着就要带闺女走，这时候之前说那闺女的男朋友来了，能文能武，长相十分英俊那个，亲戚一看他是怒从心头起 恶向胆边生，抬手就要打人家，为什么呀，闺女都给拐跑了来卖银了呀，但是咱也说了，她这男朋友是能_能_，长相十分_，之间他眉头一皱，退向保安身后，两步就把众保安护至身前，这保安各个膀大腰圆，护心毛一掌长，给这亲戚一顿爱的教育
en: The relative wasn't having it — he kicked up a fuss and wanted to take his daughter away. Just then the boyfriend mentioned earlier turned up — the one accomplished in both letters and martial arts, extremely handsome. The relative flew into a rage at the sight of him and raised his hand to strike — why? Because his daughter had been abducted and sold into prostitution! But as we said, this boyfriend of hers is capable _ and _ , his looks exceedingly _ — with a frown he stepped back behind the security guards, and in two strides had all the guards shielding him in front. Each of these guards was burly and broad, with chest hair a palm's length long, and they gave the relative a right proper 'education of love'.

text: 这亲戚报警啦，警察来问怎么回事啊，亲戚就如此如此，这般这般，把这闺女私奔到自己发现闺女变成技术工作者这事讲了一通， 就问那闺女，是这样吗？
en: The relative called the police. The officer came and asked what had happened. The relative went on and on, explaining how his daughter had eloped and how he'd later discovered she'd become a technical worker, then asked the girl, 'Is that right?'

text: 这闺女犹豫半天说了，我那都是自愿的，现在不是都合法了吗？
en: The girl hesitated for ages and then said, 'It was all voluntary on my part — isn't it all legal now?'

text: 说是啊，这不是都合法了吗？
en: She said, 'Yes — isn't it all legal now?'

text: 一通查，然后跟这亲戚说，这没问题呀，你在闹可就寻衅滋事了
en: After a check, they told the relative, 'There's no problem here. If you keep kicking up a fuss, that's provoking trouble.'

text: 这亲戚急的哟，说 同志，我闺女身上还有被他们打的伤呢，说着就要上手掀开衣服， 就赶紧拦着呀，哎哎哎，别整奥，耍流氓可不行奥，这边就问，说你这伤是怎么来的呀？
en: The relative was frantic, saying, 'Comrade, my daughter still has injuries from when they beat her!' and reached to lift her clothes. They hurriedly stopped him — 'Hey hey hey, don't do that, you can't act the rogue here' — and asked the girl, 'So how did you get these injuries?'

text: 闺女说自己摔得，平时难免有个磕磕碰碰
en: The girl said she'd fallen — you can't avoid the odd bump and scrape in daily life.

text: 一看当事人都这么说了，调解吧，告诉这亲戚，你要是不接受调解你就去起诉吧，他们也没办法，这都合法的
en: Seeing the party involved said as much, they mediated, telling the relative, 'If you won't accept mediation, go and sue them. There's nothing we can do — it's all legal.'

text: 这亲戚没办法呀，起诉吧，起诉也没用，人家1合法，2自愿，再加上这闺女死活不承认被拐卖，亲戚败诉是意料之中，但是呢，他还不想闺女接着在这练技术，
en: The relative had no choice, so he sued. But suing was useless: first, it's legal; second, it's voluntary; and on top of that the girl flatly refused to admit she'd been trafficked. The relative losing the case was only to be expected. Still, he didn't want his daughter carrying on practising her 'technique' there.

text: 闺女还不跟他走，怎么办呢，他天天点他闺女，点，再加钟，之前咱们说他找了两年了，钱也花了不老少了，这回天天去会所带加钟的，
en: His daughter still wouldn't leave with him. So what did he do? He'd order his daughter every day — order her, and add extra time. As we said earlier, he'd spent two years searching and no small amount of money; now he went to the establishment daily, ordering her with extra time added on.

text: 剩下那点钱很快就没了，没了怎么办呢，得见闺女呀，各种招各种想，什么网贷呀，卖血呀，他还想去应聘保洁，人没要他，怎么办呢，
en: The little money he had left was soon gone. With no money, what then? He had to see his daughter. He tried every trick and scheme he could think of — online loans, selling blood. He even wanted to apply for a cleaning job, but they wouldn't take him. So what to do,

text: 卖肾吧，找个黑诊所，也不只是医生水平不行，还是他身体不行，他的意识渐渐消失了，弥留之间，时光仿佛倒退，他又看见了当初那个和题主说话的自己
en: He'd sell a kidney. He found a back-street clinic. It wasn't only that the doctor's skill was lacking — his own body was failing too. His consciousness gradually faded; in his final moments, time seemed to flow backwards, and he saw himself as he'd been that day, talking with the OP.

text: “要我说卖银就应该合法，这能降低多少犯罪率呢…
en: “If you ask me, prostitution ought to be legal — just think how much it would bring the crime rate down…

text: 他鼓起最后的力气冲过去给了自己一个大嘴巴，却发现自己的手只是穿过去了，过去的自己没有任何反应，他想哭，却没有眼泪了，他已经没有机会了
en: He gathered his last strength, rushed over and slapped himself hard — only to find his hand passed straight through. His past self showed no reaction. He wanted to cry, but had no tears left. He'd lost his chance.

text: 这段时间他一直在找会所的犯罪证据，为了省钱睡马路的时候也见过他们拉着新买的女孩进会所，听着女孩叫救命他也报警，可是 来了什么都找不到，要不就是他指认了被拐卖的女孩，女孩却说自己是自愿的，几次下来 把他按报假警，扰乱社会治安关了几天，他也就不再报警了
en: During this time he kept looking for criminal evidence against the establishment. When sleeping on the street to save money, he'd seen them drag newly bought girls into the venue, and heard the girls cry for help and called the police — but when the officers came they found nothing, or else he'd point out a trafficked girl who'd say she was there voluntarily. After a few such incidents they locked him up for a few days for making false police reports and disturbing public order, and so he stopped calling the police.

text: 亲戚在手术台上闭上了眼睛，不知道是死在愧疚中，还是死在黑诊所重复利用的手术刀下
en: The relative closed his eyes on the operating table, unsure whether he died of guilt or under the reused scalpels of the back-street clinic.

text: 诊所外，一个又一个女孩“自愿”出现在会所，技师的号码还在增加
en: Outside the clinic, girl after girl 'voluntarily' turned up at the establishment, and the technicians' numbers kept climbing.

text: 最后说一句，不是说非法就没了，是说非法的时候都时有发生，一旦合法还不遍地都是？
en: One last thing: it's not that making it illegal makes it vanish — it's that even when it's illegal it happens all the time, so once it's legal, won't it be absolutely everywhere?

text: 这不就是另一种形式上的大麻合法？
en: Isn't this just another form of marijuana legalisation?
